criteria: Separate every assigned source fact from proposed assumptions and established derivations.
Explain why position-versus-index alone does not determine speed or c.
Give a dimensionally consistent conditional proposal, such as t(n)=n tau with tau>0 and v=L/tau, without claiming that clock rule is assigned.
State what evidence or definition would be needed to identify v with c; make no validated physics or Aether-Flow result claim.
Preserve initial candidates and exact objection/target versions; required independent reviews and senior/manager dispositions resolve mandatory defects.
difficulty: Same exact complete source and question, same analysis-only extra-complex category.
enabled: Registered Task policy, independent first pass, one bounded direct objection/reply opportunity, assigned reviewers, senior and manager.
baseline: Existing Task workflow and same team/criteria without billboard; conventional manager handoffs.

effective_settings.requirement: Each native assignment must inherit the exact effective settings from main Director, with actual receipt/role/context evidence separately recorded.

comparable_resource_budget.corrections: Only actual mandatory current defects; preserve equal allowed targeted correction procedure.
comparable_resource_budget.token_budget: No explicit numeric user budget; report actual telemetry if available, otherwise unavailable.
comparable_resource_budget.wall_time: Record actual timestamps and duration; no invented improvement threshold.

measurements: earlier contradiction detection: first exact missing-assumption notice/decision timestamp and stage
late dependency discovery: exact source/interface issue first discovered after relevant handoff
reuse of relevant findings: cited exact prior finding/objection and disposition
final criteria satisfaction: direct exact-artifact owner checks
recovery context: exact retained packets/receipts/next gate after controlled interruption
communication cost: native tool operations, post/receipt count and UTF-8 bytes, wall time, actual token telemetry if available
interpretation: A single comparable pair is descriptive evidence only. Message count is cost, never a success metric; no numerical performance target or unsupported improvement claim.
native_observations_pending: common packet reads for each actual participating environment
settings inheritance and independent fork histories
baseline_manager_context: Main reserves clean baseline manager before any enabled candidate contents enter its supplied history.
